calculation.expression: [((R20 - CSMedian(R20)) - (R60 - CSMedian(R60)))] * clip(1 + 1.5*(Efficiency60 - CSMedian(Efficiency60)), 0.70, 1.30), lagged 1 day
calculation.description: Relative 20-versus-60 day momentum acceleration, scaled toward assets whose 60-day absolute displacement is efficient relative to cumulative absolute daily movement. Efficiency is abs(R60) divided by the 60-day rolling sum of absolute daily returns. Cross-sectional medians and the one-day lag avoid look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: 10d IC by regime: 2020-2023 0.02093 (1182 dates), 2024-2026 0.01256 (1048), 2027-2029 0.05576 (782), 2030-2032 0.10833 (784), 2033-2035 0.02225 (674). Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
